item.description:
Aside 1.7.14

A small update with fixes for the microphone, the live transcript and dictation.

Audio

  • The mic follows your headset. Taking AirPods off and putting them back on within a moment no longer leaves the rest of the meeting without your voice. Aside now checks the device it landed on after every switch and keeps retrying until audio returns.

Live transcript

  • The transcript no longer flickers while it fills up, and the scroll bar stays out of the way.
  • Language detection now works from what it hears while you are still speaking, so short meetings no longer stay stuck in tiny transcription windows.
  • Tooltips appear where they belong instead of flying in.

Dictation

  • Pressing the dictation key during a meeting now tells you why nothing happens.
  • A mic that hangs on start no longer blocks every later press.
  • A dictation that came back empty gets one more pass, and a lost dictation keeps its audio.

Notes and settings

  • Rewriting a note from the library keeps the attendee names the first note had.
  • The checkout quotes prices in the currency you will be charged in.
  • Settings says where your data goes, in the same words as the website.
